name: Prestige - Not Indexed Pages 2026-08-05
body:
> Report · Prestige · 2026-08-05

# Summary
This compares the GSC Page indexing report (`sc-domain:prestigeplumbingsc.com`, last updated 7/24/26) against sitemap.xml, checked 2026-08-05. The sitemap had 40 URLs. GSC showed 17 indexed and 23 not indexed. GSC only "knew about" 20 of the 40 (17 indexed plus 3 "Page with redirect"), so most of the money pages had not even been crawled.

# Not indexed (23)
- Service pages (7, highest priority): the `/services/` hub, water-heaters, tankless, drain-cleaning, leak-detection-repair, toilets-faucets-fixtures, emergency-plumbing.
- Service-area pages (7): the `/service-areas/` hub and all 6 cities.
- Core (3): about, contact, the blog index.
- Blog posts (6): water-heater-cost-bluffton-sc, tankless-vs-tank-water-heater, what-not-to-put-down-drain, tree-roots-in-sewer-line, water-softener-vs-water-filter, toilet-silently-leaking.

# Root cause
The sitemap was healthy (Success, last read Jul 21, 40 discovered). The file calls it a crawl-queue delay, not a sitemap or quality problem. The 3 "Page with redirect" URLs are likely alternate forms (non-www, no trailing slash) and worth one URL inspection.

# Actions and status
- 2026-08-05: indexing was requested for 9 URLs (the 7 service pages, the service-areas hub and Bluffton) before hitting the daily quota (about 10 per property per day).
- 14 were still to request the next day: the other 5 cities, about, contact, the blog hub and 6 blog posts.
- Next steps from the file: finish the requests, add internal links from indexed pages to the un-indexed money pages, and re-check in 1 to 2 weeks.
- Note: the city URLs changed on 2026-08-12, so the city requests made here point at old URLs (see [Prestige - SEO Baseline Audit 2026-08-12](lib:brain-prestige-seo-baseline-audit-2026-08-12)).
